title: Erdős 252: irrationality of the factorial divisor-sum series
summary: For every natural number k, the series whose nth term is the sum of the kth powers of the positive divisors of n, divided by n factorial, is irrational. This gives the positive-exponent statement of Erdős problem 252 and also includes exponent zero. The proof combines factorial-tail integrality, a finite coprime dilation grid with exact finite-difference cancellation, and incompatible progression means obtained by a fresh-prime refinement.
